name: Repurchase Agreement Type 3 Choice
definition: Specifies the type of repurchase agreement.

SpecificCollateral.name: Specific Collateral
SpecificCollateral.definition: Indicates that the repurchase agreement is where a single, pre defined, financial instrument is sold and repurchased.

GeneralCollateral.name: General Collateral
GeneralCollateral.definition: Indicates that the repurchase agreement allows for the sale and repurchase of any of a selection of assets from a pool of eligible assets.
